summary: 13 years shipping production software — most of it on high-traffic web platforms — now focused on taking LLMs into production.

roles.title: Senior Web Developer
roles.note: Build and ship pages across dialpad.com — a Next.js App Router site on Vercel with a Contentful back end, ~1,900 pages across five locales, serving millions of visitors. Currently building a WYSIWYG page builder in Next.js: pages composed visually from modular blocks, with each block's properties mapped and kept in sync with its Contentful content model. TypeScript, React and Tailwind, with performance, SEO and accessibility as release criteria.

roles.title: Web Developer

roles.title: Senior Software Engineer

roles.title: Software Engineer

MEAN stack — Angular front end on Node.js services — with user, team and permission management, and a modular architecture so new content formats could be added independently of the generator.
